question: tiles 1-9: is the ink between the red corners a stem? tile 10: 1 stem or 2 stems?

answers.7: N -- the end of a flag connecting with its own notehead
answers.9: N -- part of an alto clef
answers.10: is a notehead - not a stem
answers.10_followup: Tile 10 has 2 notes a 3rd apart - 2 voices. The top one has a stem going up and the bottom has a stem going down
